did_you_know.text: Did you know? Chapter 25 opens with the death of Samuel the prophet. All Israel gathered to mourn him, and he was buried at his home in Ramah. Afterward, David went down to the wilderness of Paran.
Did you know? Nabal is described as a very wealthy man: he had three thousand sheep and a thousand goats, and the event when David approached him took place during sheep-shearing at Carmel.

Did you know? The text presents a sharp contrast between the couple: Abigail was intelligent and beautiful, whereas Nabal is described as harsh and evil in his dealings. Nabal is also called a Calebite, meaning that he was associated with the house of Caleb.
Did you know? David claimed that his men had protected Nabal’s shepherds and flocks in the wilderness: they had not harmed the shepherds or taken anything from them throughout their stay at Carmel.
Did you know? After Nabal’s insulting reply, David ordered his men to strap on their swords. Four hundred men went up after him, while two hundred remained with the supplies.

Did you know? Abigail quickly prepared a large gift for David and his men: two hundred loaves of bread, two skins of wine, five prepared sheep, five seahs of parched grain, one hundred clusters of raisins, and two hundred cakes of figs.

Did you know? Abigail plays on her husband’s name: “For as his name is, so is he—Nabal is his name, and folly is with him.” In her words, she asks David not to let Nabal’s behavior lead him to take revenge.
Did you know? Abigail describes David’s life as being “bound in the bundle of the living” with the LORD, while she compares his enemies to a stone hurled from a sling.
Did you know? David gives thanks to the LORD and to Abigail for preventing him from shedding blood. He accepts her words and gives up his plan to harm Nabal and his household.

Did you know? Only in the morning, after Nabal had sobered up from the wine, did Abigail tell him what had happened. His heart died within him, and he became like a stone; about ten days later, the LORD struck him, and he died.
